title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → AcademicPeriod
description: Maps Ellucian Banner term validation tables to the HELIX AcademicPeriod resource.

source_tables.description: Term Validation. Master list of terms with codes and descriptions.
Term Part-of-Term. Sub-term/session definitions with start/end dates.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Derive from term code pattern or institutional calendar type. Most Banner shops: '10'=Fall semester, '20'=Spring semester, '30'=Summer. Map to 'semester', 'quarter', etc.
attribute_mappings.notes: Banner term codes follow YYYYMM convention at most institutions but this is not enforced by the system.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Banner ACYR to YYYY-YYYY format. Banner stores as '2627' → '2026-2027'.
Cast to ISO 8601 date. Use the full-term part-of-term record (typically SOBPTRM_PTRM_CODE = '1').
attribute_mappings.notes: Census date is critical for official enrollment reporting (IPEDS, state). Some institutions store this differently.

attribute_mappings.transformation: true if current date is between start_date and end_date, false otherwise
